questions.question: Will you register this machine as the self-hosted GitHub Actions runner now (procedure in parity/STORE.md §5.1), or defer it?
questions.context: Registration needs a runner token from the repository's Settings → Actions → Runners, i.e. your GitHub credentials, so an agent cannot do it (decision 022). Everything else is done: store, init/record/fetch/verify, tests, and .github/workflows/parity.yml with a hosted CPU lane and an `oracle` job pinned to [self-hosted, windows, x64, uzpainter-gpu]. The oracle job stays off until the repository variable UZP_GPU_RUNNER=registered is set, and never runs for pull requests. Steps: init the store outside the repo, download the runner to e.g. C:\actions-runner, `config.cmd --url ... --token ... --labels uzpainter-gpu`, add UZP_PARITY_STORE to the runner's .env, start `run.cmd` in your logged-in session, set UZP_GPU_RUNNER=registered, then dispatch the Parity workflow.
